p: Singleton will remain behind Carter until he improves in protection and third-down play.
His snap share and upside are limited by pass-protection and third-down understanding.
Nick is still growing in that regard.
Singleton will get a couple more touches than last week's, though his reads are still developing.
He is trending positively and the team wants to feed him more, but his read ability limits how big his role can get right now.
he's going in the right direction.
